description: This file defines a feature class for listing tags in a C# ASP.NET Core project. It contains a query request and a query handler that retrieves tags from the database context, ordering them by TagId and returning a tags envelope.

classes.name: List.Query
classes.description: Represents a request for a list of tags, implements IRequest returning TagsEnvelope.

classes.name: List.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the query to list tags, interacts with ConduitContext to retrieve and return tags encapsulated within a TagsEnvelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronous method that processes the query to retrieve tags from the database, returning a TagsEnvelope with the list of tag IDs.
